name: Ena (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ena city emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised bird with outstretched wings.
history: Municipal flag of Ena, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 July 1954.

features.role: Ena city emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised bird with outstretched wings
